display_long_description:
Gorilla Mods is a new, exciting, and thrilling experience built around fast-paced gorilla locomotion. Swing, climb, and move freely through immersive environments using intuitive movement mechanics that feel both fun and rewarding to master.

With Gorilla Mods, you get access to a wide variety of unique and entertaining mods designed to enhance gameplay and create unforgettable moments. Whether you're looking to experiment with new abilities, mess around with chaotic features, or just explore creative ways to play, there’s always something new to try.

Jump in with your friends and enjoy hilarious, unpredictable, and action-packed sessions together. From casual fun to wild modded experiences, Gorilla Mods brings a fresh twist to social VR gameplay, making every session feel different and exciting.
